# Shared cross-implementation vectors of sync-core (contract 13_sync_core/wasm_exports.md, AZ-3969).
# Consumers: native runner (src/sync-core-wasm/tests/vectors.rs), WASM runner in Node and the browsers
# (src/sync-core-wasm/js/run-vectors.mjs), the UniFFI leg (17), the web Worker tests (16).
# Generated by src/sync-core-wasm/examples/gen_vectors.rs from the native implementation; changing any
# expectation is a protocol change. Gate: scripts/ci/check-wasm-vectors.sh.
#
# Test bytes: byte i of a file is (i mod 251). Files are generated, never stored. Blocks are 2097152 bytes,
# the last may be shorter. Hashes are lower-case hex. Fields are separated by single spaces; lines
# starting with # are comments.
#
#   file <name> <length> <file_hash> <block_hash>[,<block_hash>...]   block list is - for a zero-length file
#   oversize <name> <length>                                          one block of this length must be rejected
#   client_key <name> <device_id> <asset_id> <file_hash> <client_key> mobile key; asset_id has no spaces
#   commit_id <name> <unix_ms> <random_hex_10_bytes> <uuid>           UUIDv7 from caller time and random bytes
#   planner <name> <block_count> <need> <lanes_max> <retry_base_ms> <retry_max_ms> <max_attempts> <events> <expected>
#     need: comma-separated block indexes or -. events: ;-separated, applied in order:
#       Acked:i  HashRejected:i  Transient:i:ms|-  BlockConflict:i:ms|-  SessionGone:i  Session:need
#       Commit:Ok  Commit:BlocklistMismatch  Commit:SessionGone  Commit:NeedBlocks:need
#     expected: /-separated action lists, one for the first next_actions() and one after each event;
#       a list is ,-separated actions or - when empty:
#       SendBlock:i  Wait:ms  RereadSession  Commit  Done  RestartSession  GiveUp:i
